editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Four stanzas plus chorus; printed under the first-line title "On a Hill Far Away" (tune THE OLD RUGGED CROSS, copyright 1913). Interlinear text split into 12,8,12,8 lines, syllable hyphens rejoined, echo/alto words ("cross, the old rugged cross") and Amen omitted; spellings "suff'ring" and "suff'red" kept as printed.
